guides.favoredWhen: Even. She dodges with E and denies heals, so vary the chain and all-in after you hold her R.

keyTips.text: Even lane: she plays around your E, so vary it.
She stands behind minions at 1 against E: open with Q poke instead.
She Ignites before your heals and denies W healing: commit through, not into, the Ignite.

tips.text: She E-dodges your E: hold the chain until her dash is spent.
She dodges Q2: lead the second blast.
Her E2 interrupts your dashes: E once, then walk.
Hold the stolen R for her engage: the later R wins.
E varied plus stolen-R held: the Akali who never dodges everything never wins.

sources.author: Anguish333
sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; title claims 2000LP GrandMaster EUW and Challenger EUNE) · Akali main

guides.favoredWhen: Even. The lane revolves around your chain. Land E and it hurts, miss it and she punishes.

keyTips.text: Even lane that revolves around your chain: landings decide everything.
She trades when your E is down (about {cd:517:E}): the cooldown is the lane.
She buffers Charm through E2 and times Charm to cancel the chain: expect the answer.

tips.text: Do not eat free poke: her Qs set up Charm-cancels.
Landings hurt badly: one E2 is the whole trade.
After 6, steal her R to chase her down the lane.
She calls ganks: track her jungler when you commit.
Chain landed plus stolen-R chase: the Ahri who never dodges never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: Her E2 decides every trade. Dodge it and punish hard, eat it and lose.

keyTips.text: Her E2 decides every trade: hit means you lose, miss means you punish hard.
Take Bone Plating: it covers the trade you fail to dodge.
Stand near creeps: her E turns awkward, but not where her Q hits you and the wave.

tips.text: Deny her the snowball: your E2 is the only trade she fears.
Farm behind offset creeps: awkward angles cut her accuracy.
Do not let her keep the wave on her side for free: crash to deny the setup.
Engage only when her E is spent: no scatter means no answer.
E2 dodged plus Plating held: the Syndra who never lands E never wins.

sources.author: Trisend3
sources.rankClaim: Challenger (title and profile badge) · Syndra main

guides.favoredWhen: Zed-favoured. Force early before Voltaic, and hold your steal for his commit.

keyTips.text: Zed-favoured: he outranges and outscales your windows.
He refuses trades before Voltaic: your window is the pre-spike lane.
He plays to deny your R steal with R-first: hold your steal for his commit.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: Force before Voltaic: poke and E2 while his shadows are weak.
He positions inside the wave or far back: E the wave-stander, Q the farmer.
After Voltaic his poke finds you: track shadows before engaging.
Track his W cooldown: shadow-down is your engage.
Death Mark lands him behind you: pre-aim E at the exit when he ults.
Pre-spike banked plus steal held: the Zed who never snowballed never wins.
